from Grace |quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Vortex''' is a [[cold]] [[spell]] that deals damage in an area around the [[character]] and leaves a [[ground effect]] that both chills ([[chilled ground]]) and deals cold damage over time. ==Skill functions and interactions== *{{c|mod|Modifiers to Spell Damage apply to this skill's Damage Over Time Effect}}: Modifiers to spell damage only affect the specific damage over time effect of Vortex, not other types of damage over time that may be applied by the skill, such as [[poison]] or {{il|Decay Support}}. * '''Overlap''': If multiple Vortex ground effects apply to the same enemy, only the highest damage per second effect will deal damage. This is consistent with other damage over time debuffs without special exceptions. *'''On hit effects:''' Because the initial blast counts as a hit, Vortex can be used with on-hit effects such as {{il|Hextouch Support}}. [[Chilling Area]]: Enemies inside a chilling area become chilled. This chilling area is affected by the player and skill's modifiers to the effect of cold/non-damaging ailments, but its chills are not considered inflicted by the player. It cannot apply ''chilled by you'' stats, cannot make the player count as having chilled recently, and can chill regardless of stats that prevent the application of chill by the player, such as {{il|Elemental Focus}} or {{psl|Secrets of Suffering}}. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Cold
